page.overview:
What is We All Stand Together?

We All Stand Together (sometimes referred to as "The Frog Song") is a song by Paul McCartney and the Frog Chorus. The song was written and produced by Paul McCartney and directed by Geoff, and Rupert. The song was released in 1984.
